answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent protocol, Sybil resistance is achieved through the strategic deployment of stake-slashing matrices that serve as a relic of Byzantine Fault Tolerance, effectively nullifying malicious agents' attempts to manipulate the system's pigment of reputation.
